commands.text:
git lfs pull --include="TRUST-CPF方案/10/**"
python tools/register_trustcpf_abc.py --check
python tools/reproduce.py materialize --line TRUST-CPF方案 --stage 10 --dest "$HOME/experiments/trust-10-replay"
cd "$HOME/experiments/trust-10-replay/trustcpf_abc_v1_10ep"
python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_abc.py -v

conda activate vgcpod_v1
export CPF_REPO="$PWD"
git lfs pull --include="TRUST-CPF方案/09/results/raw_export/**,TRUST-CPF方案/10/**"
python tools/reproduce.py materialize --line TRUST-CPF方案 --stage 10 --dest "$HOME/experiments/trust-10-replay"
cd "$HOME/experiments/trust-10-replay/trustcpf_abc_v1_10ep"
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python run.py setup \
  --source "$CPF_REPO/TRUST-CPF方案/09/results/raw_export/trustcpf_stage_v1_10ep" \
  --cache /data/xhw/vgcpod_v1_runs/cache_ut_clip_l14 \
  --work "$PWD/work"
mkdir -p logs
nohup bash scripts/run_all.sh 1 2 3 > logs/queue.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
echo $! > logs/queue.pid
tail -F logs/queue.log

conda activate vgcpod_v1
cd /data/xhw/experiments
sha256sum -c trustcpf_abc_v1_10ep.zip.sha256
unzip -q -o trustcpf_abc_v1_10ep.zip
cd /data/xhw/experiments/trustcpf_abc_v1_10ep

python -c 'import sys, torch, numpy; print("Python:", sys.executable); print("Torch:", torch.__version__); print("NumPy:", numpy.__version__); print("CUDA:", torch.cuda.is_available()); print("GPUs:", torch.cuda.device_count())'

python run.py setup \
  --source /data/xhw/experiments/trustcpf_stage_v1_10ep \
  --cache /data/xhw/vgcpod_v1_runs/cache_ut_clip_l14 \
  --work /data/xhw/experiments/trustcpf_abc_v1_10ep/work

cd /data/xhw/experiments/trustcpf_abc_v1_10ep
mkdir -p logs
nohup bash scripts/run_all.sh 1 2 3 > logs/queue.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > logs/queue.pid
tail -f logs/queue.log

nohup bash scripts/run_all.sh 0 1 2 > logs/queue.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > logs/queue.pid

nvidia-smi
ps -u "$USER" -o pid,etime,args | grep -E 'run_queue.py|run.py' | grep -v grep

cd /data/xhw/experiments/trustcpf_abc_v1_10ep
nohup bash scripts/run_all.sh 1 2 3 >> logs/queue.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > logs/queue.pid

git lfs pull --include="TRUST-CPF方案/10/**"
python tools/analyze_trustcpf_abc.py --dest "$HOME/analysis/trust-10-recompute"
